description: Create a List - Create a new, empty contact list. It needs source (csv_upload, crm_import, form_signup, existing_customer or event_attendee) and source_reference (where the list came from or how consent was obtained: the file name, CRM name, form name or event name); calls without them are rejected, and both are stored with the list. This tool takes no email addresses; add contacts afterwards with add_contacts, which needs the same two fields. Recipients must be the account holder's own contactable audience. Blocklist and unsubscribes are always enforced. The response includes a `fields` array — the list's columns in snake_case (e.g. first_name, email).

archive_invalid.description: Archive contacts with invalid emails after verification

archive_risky.description: Archive contacts with risky emails after verification

folder.description: Optional general folder ID to organize the list. Must be a folder created without a type (i.e., not an email-sender folder).

source.description: REQUIRED. Where these contacts came from.

source_reference.description: REQUIRED. Where the list came from or how consent was obtained: the file name, CRM name, form name or event name. Describes the account holder's actual source for these contacts.

verification.description: Enable email verification for contacts in this list

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: create_list

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Create List
